examples.vi: Y tá đã ghi lại lần cân hàng tuần của đứa bé.

thesaurus.definition: careful consideration

examples: She took her baby to the clinic for regular weighings.
wiktionary.gloss: The process by which something is weighed.
That weighs or burdens.

blocks.etymology: Probably an alteration of wedge. Compare wad.
vi_block: [[|]] một miếng lớn, một khối lượng lớn.

examples: He paid a wodge of dosh for his new motor from the car dealership.
wiktionary.gloss: A bulk mass, usually of small items, particularly money; a wad

blocks.etymology: From Ancient Greek ξένος (xénos, “foreign, strange”) + -on, used for all noble gases.

thesaurus.definition: a colorless odorless inert gaseous element occurring in the earth's atmosphere in trace amounts

wiktionary.gloss: The chemical element (symbol Xe) with an atomic number of 54. It is a colorless, odorless, unreactive noble gas, used notably in camera flash technology.

vi_block: Vạch màu vàng chỉ giới hạn đỗ xe.

wiktionary.gloss: A straight line painted in yellow on the side of a road, to indicate that parking is restricted.

blocks.etymology: Semi-Calque of German Der Mensch ist, was er ißt (literally “The human/man is what he eats”), coined in 1850 by Ludwig Feuerbach in a review of Jacob Moleschott’s Lehre der Nahrungsmittel. Für das Volk (Erlangen, 1850). Compare German man ist, was man isst.

wiktionary.gloss: Personal health and wellbeing is determined by one's eating habits, in both positive and negative ways.

examples: They're going to have a baby? You don't say!
Hey, guess what? There's a country called Brazil! –You don't say.
wiktionary.gloss: Really?; no kidding!; is that so? (sometimes used sarcastically in response to the obvious)

blocks.etymology: From zoo- + psychologist.
vi_block: Nhà tâm lý học động vật.

wiktionary.gloss: One who studies or practices zoopsychology.
